v4.6.115 — Bot market redesign + Day P/L fix

🛒 The bot market now matches the app: compact cards with broker LOGOS (Alpaca / IBKR) and AI-provider icons instead of text, the description tucks away until you click a card, and Install is a solid button that lights up on hover (no more link-y feel).

📊 Day P/L now shows for every bot, not just one — it measures the full session (since the previous close) the way a broker does, with a guard so a deleted-then-re-added bot can't show a garbage number.

🤖 The marketplace starter bots run on BOTH Alpaca and IBKR and are compatible with every AI provider (Claude, GPT, Groq, Gemini).

Update via the in-app banner.
